svg.aria-label: Gray's Anatomy engraving of the lateral thorax with the ribs, the lung in purple, the pleura in blue and the spleen in green. A line along a rib rises toward the back at about 24 degrees compared with a dashed true horizontal from the level of the nipple. Below the lung the pleura continues as the costodiaphragmatic recess, a band with no lung in it, with the spleen just beneath the diaphragm. Plate by Henry Vandyke Carter, Gray's Anatomy 1918, public domain.
